description: Fix 3 issues from v2 code review: vm_push overflow not halting execution, intern table probe chain corruption on GC sweep, and unsigned underflow in string_replace buffer size.
steps: Add vm.had_error check to DISPATCH macro so stack overflow halts VM execution
Implement tombstone sentinel for intern table so remove_unmarked preserves probe chains
Fix string_replace_method to use signed arithmetic for buffer size calculation
acceptance_criteria: Stack overflow via vm_push causes the VM to halt with INTERPRET_RUNTIME_ERROR
Intern table GC sweep preserves probe chains using tombstones
string_replace with shorter replacement computes correct buffer size
verification: Run 'make test' and confirm all tests pass
findings: All 3 issues fixed successfully. (1) DISPATCH macro now checks vm.had_error before dispatching next opcode - if set, returns INTERPRET_RUNTIME_ERROR immediately. (2) INTERN_TOMBSTONE sentinel added as a static ObjString* that intern_table_find skips, intern_table_insert reuses, intern_table_grow discards, and intern_table_remove_unmarked places instead of NULL. (3) string_replace_method uses int64_t delta and int64_t new_len_s to compute buffer size, with a safety floor of 0. All 99 unit tests + 8 integration tests pass. Manual test confirms 'hello'.replace('llo','') correctly produces 'he'.
